ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central contiguous white field. Low-intensity black border (5-20 pixel depth) along the trailing edge and tips. Vertical low-intensity black column extending from the peduncle base to the median notch. Multiple isolated low-intensity pixel clusters (points) scattered within the high-intensity white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (sawtooth pattern) along the left trailing edge. Irregular, higher-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys concentrated on the distal third of the right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, sweeping from the central notch to the lateral terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Six discrete circular dark-on-white pixel clusters (3-6 pixel diameter) identified: two in the mid-left lobe field and four in the mid-right lobe field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical grey linear pixel disruptions visible in the lower-left quadrant near the transition to the central black column.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation at the far right terminal tip, indicating a deviation from the expected symmetric geometric taper.
other_distinctive_markers: Single high-contrast reddish-brown pixel cluster located in the upper-mid section of the right lobe field.
